localBackupsSubtitle: Local snapshots of flows, settings.js and key files, with restore and retention.
failedToLoad: Could not load the backup list
retryLoad: Check that the NRCC backend is running, then retry.
createFirstDesc: Create one now, or set a schedule below to take them automatically.

list.title: Available backups
list.desc: Select a name to see its files. Download, restore or delete a snapshot from its row.

summary.noneDesc: Create the first one to start the local history.
summary.saveToActivate: Save a schedule to start automatic backups.

syncError.status: Could not refresh the scheduler status.
syncError.observability: Could not refresh the backup history.
syncError.body: The data on screen may be out of date. Retry to resync.

restore.title: Restore backup
restore.description: Replaces the instance's current files with the files in this backup.

steps.snapshot: A pre-restore snapshot of the current files is taken, so you can undo this.
steps.replace: The backup's files are verified, then replace the current ones: flows, NRCC users and, if included, settings.js, credentials and package.json. If verification fails, nothing is replaced.
steps.start: Node-RED starts again, even if the restore failed. No readiness check runs; to undo, restore the pre-restore snapshot.

delete.title: Delete backup
delete.description: Deletes this backup file from the instance. This cannot be undone.

scheduler.title: Schedule
scheduler.desc: Take automatic backups at a fixed frequency, or once at a set date and time.

presets.custom: Once, at a set date and time

scheduler.cronHint: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.
scheduler.invalidCron: Invalid cron expression. Use five fields, for example 0 2 * * *.
scheduler.pickDateTime: Pick a date and a time.

retention.title: Retention
retention.desc: How many backups of each type to keep. When a new backup is taken, the oldest of that type beyond this count are deleted.

backupIdentifierInvalid: The backup has no valid identifier
backupCronRequired: Enter a cron expression for a one-off schedule
couldNotSaveBackupConfiguration: Could not save the backup schedule
noBackupsConfigured: No backups yet. Configure the scheduler to start creating backups automatically.
